title: [Informações do servidor] COLETA DE RECURSOS (Flower, Cactus, Ore)
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

GENERAL INFORMATION
  • Gathering resources is a new in-game activity for any type of player, where anyone, at almost any level and in any equipment, can obtain valuable rewards simply by carefully inspecting specific locations and gathering (destroying) resources.
  • Gathering resources appear at absolutely random points in the location, which makes it impossible to farm these resources while staying "in one spot". It is necessary to constantly move and look for resources in different places (within the location).
  • In one location, there are 3 grades of gathering resources of the same type: Grade 1 - very common and has a reduced reward, Grade 2 - rare and has a significant average reward, Grade 3 - incredibly rare and insanely valuable.
  • Gathering resources have random spawn times and a random spawn chance. On average, per hour in one location, there appear: 500 Grade 1 resources, 50 Grade 2, and 0.33 Grade 3.
    • Due to absolute randomness, there may appear either half as many or twice as many resources per hour; average values are indicated.
    • provided that the resources are being farmed by someone; if nobody is killing them, the maximum number that can be on the map is 80 resources.
  • The drop from gathering resources is not 100%, you can use loot increase potions to improve the chances of loot.


TYPES OF GATHERING RESOURCES


Frozen Flowers:

Located on Ether, drop currency.
On average per hour, from all flowers drops:
Stage 1.1 - 150kk currency
Stage 1.2 - 300kk currency
Stage 1.3 - 350kk currency
Stage 1.4 - 400kk currency
  • Grade 1 - Icy Flower
  • Grade 2 - Frosty Fern
  • Grade 3 - Heart of Ice



Ore Deposits:

Located in Crag Mines, drop gold points.
On average per hour, from all ore drops:
Stage 1.1 - 2000 gold points
Stage 1.2 - 2400 gold points
Stage 1.3 - 3000 gold points
Stage 1.4 - 3500 gold points
  • Grade 1 - Mithril Deposits
  • Grade 2 - Orichalcum Deposits
  • Grade 3 - Heart of Caves

Hunter Cactuses:
Located in Desert of Hunters, drop hunting points and herodian chip shards.


Spiky Cactuses:

Located in Sette Desert, drop various resources.
  • Also from cactuses drop Cactus Seeds trophy of the current stage, which allows taking the Adventurer's quest.
    Cactus seeds can also be listed and purchased on the web-race auction.
  • Also Cactus Seed trophey can be obtained from "Desert Remains" cactuses, which respawn accross Heroic Cactus after the death of the Heroic Cactus.
    Heroic Cactus appears at Nadir Plain at 12:10, 15:10, 21:10, 00:10 Moscow time (09:10, 12:10, 18:10, 21:10 GMT / 13:10, 16:10, 19:10, 01:10 WIB)
    If the Heroic Cactus was not killed within 30 minutes – the Heroic Cactus will disappear, but the desert remains will still respawn.

On average per hour, about 150 Cactus leaves drop (from all cactuses in the location)
  • Grade 1 - Cactus
  • Grade 2 - Spiky Cactus
  • Grade 3 - Heart of Sand
5 cactus leaves of the current stage = Cactus reward box of the current stage
